tasks.name: Task: Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser
tasks.description: Disables the scheduled task \Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser (telemetry/diagnostics/background work).
tasks.apply_script:
$t = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\' -TaskName 'Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($t) { if (-not $WhatIfPreference) { Disable-ScheduledTask -InputObject $t | Out-Null } } else { Write-OptiLog 'Task Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser not present; skipped.' 'Warn' }
tasks.undo_script:
$t = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\' -TaskName 'Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($t) { if (-not $WhatIfPreference) { Enable-ScheduledTask -InputObject $t | Out-Null } } else { Write-OptiLog 'Task Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser not present; skipped.' 'Warn' }
